title: Arte de Papel Cortado en Capas Día-Noche de Viena: Elegancia Imperial Habsburgo con la Catedral Stephansdom
prompt: Paper cut layered art: Vienna (Wien) day-night elegant diagonal split (top-left to bottom-right) with soft artistic transition. Core: ONE St. Stephen's Cathedral (Stephansdom) bisected diagonally with elegant gradient - warm golden tones on day side (orange, peach, coral, amber, imperial yellow) and cool tones with rich warm lights on night side (navy, purple, midnight blue, with abundant yellow windows, red lanterns, vibrant Austrian red-white accents). CRITICAL AESTHETIC REQUIREMENTS: Beautiful visually stunning composition, rich details and intricate paper cut patterns, elegant color harmony with Viennese Baroque aesthetics, sophisticated ornamental decorative elements, high artistic value with refined craftsmanship. Text: WIEN in beautiful German Gothic calligraphy, split by diagonal with elegant transition, surrounded by exquisite Habsburg imperial eagles, classical music notes, and Baroque architectural ornaments, strong dimensional depth with layered shadow effects. Day side (left/top): Brilliant golden sun with radiating warm rays, gorgeous warm amber/peach/coral sky with coffee house elegance, sophisticated imperial atmosphere. Beautiful daytime elements - Sachertorte with rich chocolate glaze and apricot filling, Wiener Schnitzel with golden crispy coating, Apple Strudel with flaky pastry layers, fresh Kaisersemmel rolls; stunning white Lipizzaner horses with detailed manes in cream color, Austrian Alpine flowers with vibrant petals; magnificent Danube River in bright blue reflection with gentle ripples; Schönbrunn Palace with ornate Baroque details glowing in sunlight, traditional Fiaker horse carriage with refined details, classical concert scene at Musikverein with musicians. Diagonal transition: Soft gradient with twilight beauty - golden amber, warm peach, soft lavender, deep violet, midnight blue - creating elegant natural flow embodying imperial grandeur meeting modern Vienna. Night side (right/bottom): Gorgeous blue/silver moon with ethereal glow and sparkling stars, rich deep navy and midnight blue sky with beautiful depth. Spectacular nighttime atmosphere with abundant warm light sources creating magical Viennese ambiance - numerous glowing yellow windows creating patterns in elegant apartment buildings, elegant orange street lamps along Ringstrasse, beautiful traditional Christmas market lights with warm golden glow, stunning purple-magenta illuminated Riesenrad Ferris wheel, brilliant cyan-teal lit Danube Tower, golden light from opera house glows, rich amber reflections in palace fountains. Night elements - dazzling illuminated Hofburg Palace with golden lighting effects, magnificent glowing St. Stephen's Cathedral spire, charming evening ball scene at palace with waltzing atmosphere, vibrant coffeehouse culture with warm window lights. Unified elements (each appears once with elegant transition): Stephansdom showing beautiful gradient from day to night, Hofburg Palace with imperial architectural details, Danube River with reflection changes from day to night, Ringstrasse boulevard with Baroque and Art Nouveau building styles, Lipizzaner horses with natural beauty, vintage tram, musical notes and violin symbols with ornate decoration, harmonious blend of imperial Baroque heritage and modern Viennese culture. Craft technique: 10-12 distinct paper layers with EXTREME pronounced depth and dimension, very thick visible edges (4-6mm thickness showing dimension), dramatic shadows creating powerful 3D sculptural relief effect, each element shows intricate multi-layer construction with refined details, ornate Baroque and Art Nouveau decorative patterns throughout (imperial eagles, musical motifs, floral arabesques), side-lighting creating stunning dimensional effect emphasizing Habsburg elegance. Format: landscape orientation, no border, no frame, elegant soft diagonal transition (clear enough to show duality but refined and artistic), sophisticated visual balance, BEAUTIFUL and STUNNING overall aesthetic capturing Viennese imperial grace. The artwork should be visually gorgeous, elegant, majestic, romantic - capturing the imperial heritage and musical soul of Vienna as the waltz capital of Europe.
